name: Rahil Ehtesham Mehr
bio: I’m a physics undergraduate at Sharif University of Technology, interested in experimental condensed matter physics, thin films, two-dimensional materials, and materials science.

My current research focuses on thin films and two-dimensional materials, where I’m gaining hands-on experience in material fabrication and characterization. I’m interested in how material properties relate to structure and interfaces, and in their potential applications in emerging materials and devices.

My research background also includes computational modeling of light–tissue interactions with Dr. Rasoul Sedighi, including photon transport in multilayer skin models. I welcome opportunities to exchange ideas, discuss research, and collaborate.
personal: Beyond physics, I’m a [FIDE-rated chess player][fide-profile], a member of Sharif’s university chess team, and a certified chess instructor. I taught at Shahmate chess school from March 2023 to July 2026. Competitive chess has shaped my analytical thinking, strategic decision-making, and approach to complex problems. I also organize university tournaments and contribute chess puzzles to the university newspaper. Away from the board, I enjoy running, skating, karate, cinema, and tea.
highlight: I am currently looking for graduate-level positions in experimental physics for the 2027 cohort.
